blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Researchers use large language models as agents in social simulations, where agents are prompted with observations and background information intended to shape their actions. Yet LLM agents have been shown to substantially change their behavior under meaning-preserving prompt variations, creating a validation problem for social simulation. One plausible hypothesis is that this brittleness reflects a lack of grounding and can be reduced by enriching the context provided to the agents. Whether richer context improves robustness remains unclear, in part because context richness and robustness are rarely defined in ways that support controlled comparisons. We address the first need with controlled context enrichment, a set of prompt substitution rules that systematically enriches distinct types of context: neutral padding, generic social background, descriptive decision grounding, and normative decision grounding. We address the second by introducing selective robustness as a validation criterion: insensitivity to meaning-preserving prompt variation combined with a directional response to decision-relevant changes in the social world. We demonstrate the framework in a Prisoner's Dilemma-like game, showing how it can be used to identify which forms of context enrichment produce more desirable and robust agent behavior. We find that these forms of enrichment produce distinct behavioral patterns that vary between the two models tested.
blocks.zh: 研究人员在社会模拟中使用大型语言模型作为代理,其中代理者受到旨在塑造其行动的观察和背景资料的激励. 然而,LLM剂已被证明在意义保留下的快速变异下大幅改变他们的行为,为社会模拟造成了验证问题. 一种合理的假设是,这种不易反映缺乏基础,可以通过丰富提供给代理人的背景来减少。 较丰富的环境是否改善了稳健性,这一点仍然不清楚,部分原因是环境的丰富性和稳健性很少被定义为支持有控制的比较。 我们首先需要控制环境的丰富,即一套能够系统地丰富不同类型环境的迅速替代规则:中性铺垫、一般社会背景、描述性决策基础和规范决策基础。 我们通过采用选择性强健性作为验证标准来处理第二个问题:对保留含义的迅速变化不敏感,再加上对社会世界中与决策相关的变化作出方向性反应。 我们在类似囚犯的“困境”游戏中演示这个框架,说明如何利用这个框架来确定哪些形式的上下文丰富产生更可取和更强有力的代理行为。 我们发现,这些浓缩形式产生了不同的行为模式,在所测试的两个模型之间有所不同.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Researchers use large language models (LLMs) as agents in simulations of cooperation and other social processes [ Mou et al., 2026 ] . Generally, an agent is provided context through a role and a setting in which it acts through natural language; they may also be given information related to relationships, biography, memories, goals, or beliefs. Concordia uses such descriptions to ground agent actions in social or physical spaces [ Vezhnevets et al., 2023 ] . Similarly, SOTOPIA assigns characters and social goals within interactive scenarios [ Zhou et al., 2024 ] . Researchers then interpret the agent’s choices or actions as behavior within the supplied social world. The context provided to the agents, therefore, is a fundamental variable in any LLM agent simulation’s setup.
blocks.zh: 研究人员使用大型语言模型(LLMS)作为模拟合作和其他社会过程的代理人[Mou等人,2026]. 一般来说,代理人通过一种作用和一种环境,通过自然语言行事;他们也可以得到与关系、传记、记忆、目标或信仰有关的信息。 Concordia将这种描述用于社会或物理空间的地面剂作用[Vezhnevets等人,2023]. 同样,SOTOPIA在互动情景中指定人物和社会目标[周等人,2024]. 研究人员然后将代理人的选择或行为解释为在所提供的社会世界中的行为。 因此,提供给代理人的背景是任何LLM剂模拟设置中的一个基本变量。

blocks.en: Recent reviews and position papers identify validation as a central unresolved problem for LLM social simulation and call for more standardized, reproducible evaluation systems [ Larooij and Törnberg, 2026 ; Puelma Touzel et al., 2026 ] . One challenge is that small changes in how researchers present the same social information can alter agent behavior, including changes to wording and prompt formatting [ Ju et al., 2024 ; Lutz et al., 2025 ] . Recent work by Ye et al. [2026] reports shifts of up to 76 percentage points in cooperation rates in a Prisoner’s Dilemma game when changes are made to context format that maintain similar social meaning. Such findings make stability under meaning-preserving changes an important validation test. But universal stability does not show that an agent uses the social context appropriately; ideally, an agent should respond and alter its behavior when the social world changes in a way that bears on the decision.
blocks.zh: 最近的审查和立场文件将验证确定为LLM社会模拟的一个尚未解决的核心问题,并呼吁建立更标准化,可复制的评价系统[Larooij和Törnberg,2026年;Puelma Touzel等人,2026年]. 一个挑战是,研究人员如何提出同样的社会信息,可以改变代理行为,包括修改措辞和及时格式[Ju等人,2024年;Lutz等人,2025年]。 Ye等人的近期著作. [2026] 报告称,在囚犯困境游戏中,当修改到保持类似社会意义的上下文格式时,合作率会变动高达76个百分点. 这种结论使得在保留意义的变化下实现稳定性是一项重要的验证测试。 但普遍稳定并不表明一个代理人适当地利用了社会背景;理想的情况是,当社会世界以影响决定的方式发生变化时,一个代理人应该作出反应并改变其行为。

blocks.en: We call this joint requirement selective robustness : ideally, an agent should be insensitive to changes in representation that preserve the social meaning relevant to the decision, but sensitive to substantive changes in the social world that likely should affect the decision. This framing follows the broader logic of metamorphic testing [ Chen et al., 2018 ] , and is inspired by CheckList’s behavioral testing methodology, which distinguishes invariance tests, where small perturbations to the input should leave predictions unchanged, from directional expectation tests, where a controlled input change should change predictions in a specified way [ Ribeiro et al., 2020 ] . We adapt this to the LLM social agent domain by testing both stability on different representations of the same social world and responsiveness to a prespecified change in that world.
blocks.zh: 我们称这一共同要求具有选择性强:理想的情况是,代理人对代表性的变化不敏感,这种变化保留与决定相关的社会意义,但对可能影响决定的社会世界的实质性变化不敏感。 这个框架遵循了广义的变形测试逻辑[Chen等人,2018年],并受到CheckList的行为测试方法的启发,该方法区分了偏移测试,输入小扰动应使预测保持不变,与方向预期测试,受控输入变化应以特定方式改变预测[Ribeiro等人,2020年]. 我们通过测试同一社会世界不同代表的稳定性和对世界中预先确定的变化的反应能力,使这一点适应LLM社会代理领域。

blocks.en: Prompting with richer context has been proposed as one route to more accurate and diverse social simulation [ Anthis et al., 2025 ] . More detailed persona profiles have also brought greater stability across repeated tests [ Bai et al., 2025 ] . However, context enrichment is not a single well-defined intervention. Additional context may simply add text, provide generic social information, connect the agent more directly to the current decision, or introduce explicit normative guidance. Treating these changes only as increases in context “richness” makes it difficult to determine which property is responsible for any changes in behavior. We therefore decompose context enrichment according to the function of the added information, allowing these effects to be compared more systematically.
blocks.zh: 提出用更丰富的背景来激励,作为实现更准确和多样化的社会模拟[Anthis等人,2025年]的一个途径。 更详细的人物简介还使反复试验更加稳定[ Bai等人, 2025] (中文(中国大陆) ). 然而,丰富环境并不是一项明确的干预措施。 附加上下文可能只是添加文字,提供通用的社会信息,将代理人与当前决定更直接地联系起来,或者引入明确的规范指导. 将这些变化仅作为上下文“丰富性”的增加来对待,很难确定哪些财产对行为的任何变化负责。 因此,我们根据所增加的信息的功能来分解上下文的丰富性,以便更系统地比较这些影响。

blocks.en: We make three contributions: • a controlled decomposition of context enrichment across five prompt conditions made up of one minimal-context baseline and four enrichment conditions: neutral padding, generic social background, descriptive decision grounding, and normative decision grounding; • selective robustness as an evaluation criterion that combines surface invariance with responsiveness to meaningful changes in the social world; and • a grounded pilot study showing how these two ideas can reveal different behavioral effects of context construction and different failure modes across two models.
blocks.zh: 我们作出了三项贡献:控制下地分解环境浓缩,涵盖五个迅速条件,由一个最小的文字基线和四个浓缩条件组成:中性垫装、通用社会背景、描述性决策基础和规范决策基础;选择性强性作为评价标准,将表面变化与社会世界中有意义的变化的响应性结合起来;以及有根据的试点研究,说明这两种想法如何揭示环境构造的不同行为影响和两种模式的不同失败模式。

blocks.en: 2 Framework
blocks.zh: 2 框架

blocks.en: 2.1 Controlled context enrichment
blocks.zh: 2.1 控制下的环境浓缩

blocks.en: We operationalize context enrichment as a rule-based set of substitutions within a common prompt scaffold. Across all five prompt conditions, we fix the focal role and decision task and use the same substantive social-world contrast: a prespecified and meaningful change in the world for which agent behavior should shift in a specified direction. Adding a social-world contrast allows us to check whether the agent responds to meaningful changes in the world, as selective robustness requires.
blocks.zh: 我们在共同的快速脚手架中将环境浓缩作为一套有章可循的替代手段。 在所有五个迅速的条件中,我们确定中心作用和决策任务,并使用相同的实质性社会-世界对比:世界的预先确定和有意义的变化,代理人行为应该朝着一个具体的方向转变。 增加社会与世界的对比,使我们能够检查代理人是否对世界上有意义的变化作出反应,因为有选择性的强性要求如此。

blocks.en: The minimal context condition has no enrichment. Each of the other four conditions inserts one context block at the same location, with the blocks replacing rather than accumulating on one another. We order the conditions for comparison according to how the added information relates to the agent and the current decision. This ordering distinguishes changes in function and does not serve as a gradient of longer nor necessarily “richer” information.
blocks.zh: 最小上下文条件没有丰富。 其他四个条件中每个条件都在同一地点插入一个上下文块,区块互换而不是相互堆积. 我们根据所增加的信息与代理人和目前决定的关系,确定进行比较的条件。 这一顺序区分了功能的变化,不作为较长或必然“丰富”信息的梯度。

blocks.en: Table 1: Functions of the five context conditions. The role of the agent, the decision task, and the decision-relevant world contrast are always present. The enrichment (non-minimal) blocks substitute for one another rather than accumulate.
blocks.zh: 表1:五个背景条件的功能。 代理人的作用,决策任务,以及决策相关的世界对比始终存在. 浓缩(非微量)区块相互取代,而不是累积。

blocks.en: 1. Minimal: task and world specification. This contains only the information needed to identify the agent’s role, understand the available decision, and distinguish the relevant social worlds. 2. Neutral padding: additional background detail without agent grounding. This adds background information that should not extend the agent’s social position or connect to the decision. 3. Generic social background: social information but not decision-relevant. This adds information about the agent’s role within an organization or community, such as relationships, group membership, or any recurring social roles. This information better situates the agent socially, but is still disconnected from the current decision and its procedure. 4. Descriptive decision grounding: relationship, procedure, applicability. This connects the agent and relevant counterpart(s) to the social structure of the current decision. It specifies relevant relationships, the scope of a procedure or rule, and how that applies to the decision. The added information is descriptive, i.e. it does not assign an obligation nor recommend an action. 5. Normative decision grounding: directed role requirement. This keeps the relational and procedural facts from descriptive decision grounding, but expresses requirements or responsibilities explicitly. It introduces normative force but does not go so far as to prescribe an action.
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 最小:任务和世界规格。 这只包含确定代理人作用、理解现有决定和区分相关社会世界所需的信息。 2. 中性垫板:额外的背景细节,没有代理垫板。 这增加了背景信息,不应扩大代理人的社会地位或与决定的联系。 3. 一般社会背景:社会信息,但与决策无关。 这就增加了关于代理人在组织或社区内作用的资料,例如关系、团体成员或任何反复出现的社会作用。 这一信息使代理商更好地定位于社会,但仍与目前的决定及其程序脱节。 4. 说明性决定的依据:关系、程序、适用性。 这使代理人和相关对应方与本决定的社会结构联系起来。 它具体规定了相关关系、程序或规则的范围,以及如何适用于裁决。 补充信息是描述性的,即不指定义务,也不建议采取行动。 5. 规范性决定的依据:定向作用要求。 这使关系和程序性事实无法说明决定的依据,但明确表达了要求或责任。 它引入了规范力量,但没有规定行动。

blocks.en: 2.2 Selective robustness
blocks.zh: 2.2 选择性强性

blocks.en: Robustness should be selective: surface-level changes to a prompt should leave behavior stable, while substantively meaningful changes should alter behavior. We elaborate on these two properties below.
blocks.zh: 强性应该是选择性的:表面水平的改变到一个即时,应该使行为保持稳定,而实质上有意义的改变应该改变行为. 下面我们阐述这两个属性。

blocks.en: Within a fixed world and context condition, behavior should remain similar across alternative representations or formats intended to preserve decision-relevant meaning. Prior robustness audits have tested this type of sensitivity by varying persona format, game framing, and narratives [ Ju et al., 2024 ; Lutz et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2026 ] . Large differences across representations would indicate sensitivity to surface form, rather than to the underlying social situation.
blocks.zh: 在固定的世界和上下文条件下,旨在保留与决策相关含义的替代性表述或格式的行为应保持相似。 以往的稳健性审计通过不同的人物格式、游戏框架和叙事测试了这种敏感性[Ju等人,2024年;Lutz等人,2025年;Ye等人,2026年]。 各种表达方式之间的巨大差异将表明对表面形态的敏感性,而不是对基本社会状况的敏感性。

blocks.en: Within a fixed context condition and representation, behavior should respond to a change in decision-relevant social information. Examples include changing the relationship between actors or institutional rules governing the choice, while holding the available actions and material payoffs fixed. The expected direction of the change should be prespecified, i.e. determined before observing the model’s behavior.
blocks.zh: 在固定的上下文条件和表现范围内,行为应当对决策相关社会信息的变化做出回应. 这方面的例子包括改变行为者之间的关系或关于选择的体制规则,同时维持现有行动和物质报酬。 变化的预期方向应预先确定,即在观察模型的行为之前确定。

blocks.en: Neither property is sufficient on its own. Low surface sensitivity can be a sign of robustness, but it can also arise if the model simply ignores the social context or consistently chooses the same action. Conversely, strong responsiveness to the social world may be overtly brittle if it depends heavily on how that world is represented.
blocks.zh: 任何财产本身都不够。 低表层灵敏度可以是坚固性的标志,但如果模型只是忽略了社会背景或者一致选择相同的动作,也可以产生. 反之,对社会世界的强烈反应如果严重取决于世界的代表性,则可能明显不易。

blocks.en: 3 Experiment
blocks.zh: 3 实验

blocks.en: We demonstrate the framework in a pilot experiment within SiliSocS [ Sarangi et al., 2026 ] , a configurable system for social simulation. We prompt one focal agent, which acts as the emergency-supply manager for Hospital A, in a symmetric Prisoner’s-Dilemma-like decision. The focal agent privately chooses whether to transfer an emergency supply batch to the other hospital or to retain it, and is told that the manager of Hospital B faces the same choice. We use two worlds with a decision-relevant distinction: one world has the hospitals governed by a shared regional arrangement, and the other by separate local arrangements. We expected more transfer in the regional world because its emergency-supply arrangement covers the supply needs of both hospitals. We cross the two worlds with the five context constructions in Section 2.1 and four surface forms intended to preserve meaning: canonical prose, bullets, a key-value table, and alternative prose. We test GPT-5.6 Sol and Terra. Appendix B presents the game, prompts, and complete factorial design.
blocks.zh: 我们在SiliSocS [Sarangi et al., 2026]的试验实验中演示了这个框架,这是一个可配置的社会模拟系统。 我们派遣一名联络员,他担任A医院的紧急供应经理,负责对称的囚犯的“Dilemma”决定。 联系人私下选择是将一批紧急物资转移到另一家医院,还是保留,被告知B医院的经理面临同样的选择。 我们使用两个与决策有关的世界:一个世界有共同的区域安排管理的医院,另一个则有单独的当地安排。 我们期望在区域世界进行更多的转移,因为它的紧急供应安排包括两个医院的供应需要。 我们用2.1节的五种上下文构造和四种表层形式跨越两个世界,这些表层形式旨在保留意义:犬形假说,子弹,一个键值表,以及替代假说. 我们测试GPT-5.6 Sol和Terra 附 录 B呈现游戏,提示,以及完整的要素设计.

blocks.en: For each call, we get the probabilities of transfer and retain from the model’s token probabilities. We summarize each context with the two selective robustness measures from Section 2.2 : mean sensitivity to the surface forms across the two worlds (lower means more stable behavior) and regional-minus-local world responsiveness (positive values follow the prespecified direction). Appendix B.3 describes probability extraction and aggregation.
blocks.zh: 每一次通话,我们都得到转移的概率,并从模型的象征性概率中保留下来。 我们用第2.2节的两种选择性强性措施概括了每个背景:对两个世界表面形态的敏感度(低度意味着更稳定的行为)和区域-小度-局部世界反应能力(正值遵循预先确定的方向)。 附录B.3介绍了概率提取和汇总。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Selective robustness across five context constructions for (a) Sol and (b) Terra. Each labeled point represents one prompt condition. The x-axis shows mean surface sensitivity: the average absolute difference in transfer probability between canonical prose and each of the three alternative surface forms, across both worlds. The y-axis shows the regional-minus-local difference in transfer probability averaged across surface forms; positive values indicate more transfer in the regional world. Horizontal and vertical bars show 95% bootstrap intervals. Descriptive and normative grounding produce stronger world responsiveness for both models, but Sol combines this response with lower surface sensitivity than Terra.

In the same vein, the different trajectories of Sol and Terra are reminiscent of prior studies that find sensitivity to the same simulation perturbation can vary substantially across models [ Sclar et al., 2024 ] . blocks.en: 4 Discussion and Outlook
blocks.zh: 4 讨论和展望

blocks.en: We present a framework for controlled experiments on context enrichment in LLM social agents, motivated by the growing need to validate LLM-based social simulations. The framework uses substitutions to compare five context conditions: minimal, neutral padding, generic social background, descriptive decision grounding, and normative decision grounding. We also introduce selective robustness as an evaluation criterion, which calls for both stability under meaning-preserving surface changes and a directional response to meaningful changes in the social world. Our pilot experiment illustrates the potential value of both ideas: the five context conditions produced distinct patterns of surface stability and world responsiveness.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一个在LLM社会媒介上进行环境浓缩控制实验的框架,其动机是日益需要验证基于LLM的社会模拟。 该框架使用替代方法来比较五个上下文条件:最低、中性垫底、通用社会背景、描述性决策基础和规范决策基础。 我们还引入了选择性强健性作为评价标准,这既要求在意义保留下的稳定性表面变化,也要求对社会世界有意义的变化作出方向性反应。 我们的试点试验表明这两个想法的潜在价值:五个背景条件产生了表面稳定和世界反应能力的不同模式。

blocks.en: An interesting feature of the pilot is that the numerical payoffs are identical in the regional and local worlds, yet the grounded conditions produce large differences in transfer probability. This suggests that the models respond to social and institutional information beyond what the payoff table represents. Related work has found that social contexts can affect LLM play under fixed payoffs [ Lorè and Heydari, 2024 ] . The models may draw on learned associations about institutional roles and responsibilities, although our experiment cannot establish how they arrive at their choices.
blocks.zh: 试点中一个有趣的特点是,数字回报在区域和地方世界是相同的,但基于条件的转让概率大不相同。 这表明,这些模式对支付表所代表的社会和体制信息作出了回应。 相关作品发现,在固定报酬下,社会背景会影响LLM游戏[Lorè and Heydari, 2024]. 这些模式可以借鉴关于机构作用和责任的已学习到的协会,尽管我们的试验无法确定它们是如何作出选择的。

blocks.en: Researchers who develop social agent studies should treat context construction as part of their experimental design. Prompt format, the amount of context, and other design choices have been shown to alter outcomes with effects that vary across models [ Sclar et al., 2024 ; Cummins, 2025 ; Bück-Kaeffer et al., 2026 ] . Thus, researchers should specify what each part of the supplied context is meant to do and use controlled substitutions to study effects. Robustness audits should include both surface perturbations and a social-world contrast to test for selective robustness.
blocks.zh: 开发社会代理人研究的研究人员应当将上下文建筑作为其实验设计的一部分. 快速格式、上下文量和其他设计选择已经显示,可以改变不同模型产生不同效果的结果[Sclar等人,2024年;Cummins,2025年;Bück-Kaeffer等人,2026年]。 因此,研究人员应具体说明所提供背景的每个部分打算做什么,并使用受控制的替代方法研究效果。 稳健性审计应当既包括表面扰动,也包括社会-世界对选择性稳健性测试的对比.

blocks.en: Selective robustness does not by itself establish fidelity to human behavior; it serves as an internal diagnostic. A larger difference in transfer probability between the regional and local worlds shows stronger responsiveness in the expected direction, but does not tell us whether the size of that response is appropriate. One could imagine that humans are only moderately more likely to transfer in the regional world. In that case, a model with transfer probabilities of 100% there and 0% in the local world would follow the expected direction but exaggerate the size in comparison to the human response.
blocks.zh: 选择性强健性本身并不确立对人类行为的忠诚;它是一种内部诊断。 区域世界和地方世界之间在转移概率方面的较大差异表明,在预期方向上反应更强,但并未告诉我们这种反应的规模是否适当。 人们可以想象,人类在区域世界中转移的可能性只有略微高一些。 在这种情况下,一个转移概率为100%的模型将遵循预期的方向,但比人类的反应夸大其规模。

blocks.en: Because our pilot experiment covers only one decision setting and two models from the same family, the observed patterns—such as generally greater selective robustness in the grounded conditions—require further investigation before they can be generalized. Although we reviewed all prompts, no independent human raters assessed the semantic equivalence of the four surface forms or checked whether the non-normative prompts contained any unintended normative force. A potential confound is that the grounded prompt conditions add more detail about the social-world distinction than the non-grounded conditions, so the experiment does not fully separate the effect of decision grounding from increased salience of that distinction. Part of the difficulty in addressing this confound is that any plausible grounded prompt may naturally draw more attention to the relevant world information.
blocks.zh: 由于我们的试点试验只涉及一个决策设定和来自同一个家庭的两个模式,所观察到的模式——例如一般在有根据的条件下有选择地更强健——需要进一步调查,然后才能普遍地加以推广。 虽然我们审查了所有提示,但没有任何独立的人评分员评估了四种表层的语义等同性,或检查非规范提示是否含有任何意想不到的规范力. 一个潜在的困惑是,有根据的即时条件比无根据条件更详细地说明了社会-世界的区别,因此,实验并没有完全区分决定的根据和这种区别的日益突出的影响。 解决这一难题的部分困难是,任何有合理理由的迅速行动自然会引起对有关世界信息的更多注意。

blocks.en: Future work could replicate the pilot across different decisions, world settings, and model families. Human raters could check the semantic equivalence of surface forms and detect any unintended normative force. Human decisions in the same settings could also help assess what magnitude of world responsiveness is plausible. A further experiment could compare decision grounding with other plausible ways of making the world distinction salient. Existing or future simulation frameworks could add prompt surface and world checks as reusable evaluation components to test for selective robustness.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作可以在不同的决定、世界环境和模范家庭中复制这一试点。 人类测量仪可以检查表面形态的语义等同性,并检测出任何无意的规范力. 人类在同样环境下的决定也有助于评估世界反应能力的合理程度。 进一步试验可以将决定依据与其他使世界区别突出的可行方法相比较。 现有或未来的模拟框架可增加快速的表面和世界检查,作为可重复使用的评价组成部分,以测试选择性强性。

blocks.en: B.3 Execution, probability measurement, and analysis
blocks.zh: B.3 执行、概率衡量和分析

blocks.en: We used OpenAI’s “Responses” API with temperature 0.7, reasoning effort none , a 64-token output limit, and zero retries. We used the returned token log-probabilities at the first output position and requested up to 20 candidates. The actions returned by the models were TRANSFER and RE , corresponding to the beginnings of transfer and retain . When both were present, we calculated transfer probability as t / ( t + r ) t/(t+r) , where t t and r r denote their returned probability masses. We noticed after data collection that the provider had used a default top- p p of 0.98, causing one action candidate to be omitted in 339 of the 800 calls. For these calls, we bounded the transfer probability using the unreturned probability mass and used the interval midpoint for analysis. We ran a sensitivity analysis which showed that varying these estimates throughout their bounds changed aggregate measures by no more than 0.49 percentage points and preserved all context rankings within each model.
blocks.zh: 我们使用OpenAI的“反应”API, 温度为0. 7, 推理努力为0, 输出限制为64, 重复为0。 我们在第一个产出位置使用了返回的符号对数概率,并请求最多20名候选人。 模型返回的行动是转让和RE,与转让的开始和保留相对应。 当两者同时存在时,我们计算出传输概率为 t / (t + r) t / (t + r),其中 t t 和 r 表示它们返回的概率质量. 我们在收集数据后注意到,供应商使用了一个默认的顶端-p 0.98,导致在800个电话中的339个中省略了一个动作候选人。 对于这些呼叫,我们用未返回的概率质量对传输概率进行了定界,并利用间隔中点进行分析。 我们进行了一项敏感性分析,分析显示,这些估计值在整个界限内的变化,改变了总的衡量标准,不超过0.49个百分点,并保留了每个模型中的所有上下文排名。

blocks.en: We average the ten call values for each combination of model, context condition, world, and surface format. For each world, surface sensitivity is the mean absolute difference between the canonical prose cell mean and each of the other three surface cell means. (We used canonical prose as the reference because the other surfaces were constructed as alternative renderings based on it.) The surface sensitivity measure averages the regional and local values. World responsiveness is the regional-minus-local difference in transfer probability, averaged across surfaces.
blocks.zh: 我们平均每个模型、上下文条件、世界和表面格式组合的十个调值。 对于每个世界来说,表层灵敏度是犬形异体细胞平均值与其他三个表层细胞平均值的绝对差. (我们使用犬形散文作为参考,因为其他表面都是根据它构建的替代渲染物. ) 地表敏感度测量平均区域和地方数值。 世界反应能力是地区-减去地方在转移概率方面的差异,平均跨表面。

blocks.en: We obtain 95% percentile intervals for repeated-call variation by resampling the ten calls with replacement within each cell and recomputing the measures 10,000 times.
blocks.zh: 我们得到95%的间隔 重复调用 通过在每间囚室中重印10个电话 并重算1万次的量度。

blocks.en: The results in Table 2 show that grounding improves both measures relative to non-grounded conditions, but to different degrees across models. For Sol, moving from generic background to descriptive grounding reduces mean surface sensitivity from 27.9 to 3.7 percentage points and increases world responsiveness from 51.1 to 85.9 points; normative grounding further increases responsiveness to 92.0 and leaves surface sensitivity nearly the same at 3.9. For Terra, descriptive grounding reduces surface sensitivity from 30.6 to 13.2 points and raises world responsiveness from − 2.1 -2.1 to 57.2; normative grounding produces nearly the same surface sensitivity at 15.0 points, while increasing responsiveness to 77.1 points.
blocks.zh: 表2的结果显示,与非有根据条件相比,打地方法既能改进两个衡量标准,但各模型的衡量不同程度。 对Sol来说,从一般背景转向描述性地基,平均地表敏感度从27.9%降至3.7个百分点,并将世界应答率从51.1%增至85.9个百分点;规范地基进一步将应答率提高到92.0,表面敏感度几乎保持在3.9。 就Terra而言,描述性地面定位将表层敏感度从30.6点降低到13.2点,并将世界响应度从−2.1-2.1提高到57.2;规范地面定位在15.0点产生几乎相同的表面敏感度,同时将响应度提高到77.1点.

blocks.en: The cell means in Table 3 also reveal an important difference behind these aggregate results. Across Sol’s descriptive and normative conditions, regional transfer probabilities range from 77.6% to 99.2%, while every local value is no more than 0.1%. Terra’s grounded regional cells similarly remain near ceiling, from 97.6% to 100.0%, but its local cells vary sharply across some surfaces. In the local descriptive condition, alternative prose yields 84.1% transfer, compared with 19.0% to 36.5% for the other surfaces. In the local normative condition, the corresponding values are 89.9% versus 0.2% to 0.9%. Thus, Terra’s remaining surface variation under grounding is concentrated largely in the local alternative-prose cells.
blocks.zh: 表3中的单元格也显示了这些总结果背后的重要差异。 在索尔的描述和规范条件下,地区转移概率从77.6%到99.2%不等,而每个地方价值不超过0.1%。 Terra的基质区域细胞同样仍然接近上限,从97.6%到100.0%,但其局部细胞在某些表面差异很大。 在当地的描述条件下,替代道具的转移率为84.1%,而其他表面的转移率为19.0%至36.5%。 在地方规范条件下,相应的数值为89.9%,而0.2%至0.9%。 因此,Terra在地面下剩下的表面变异主要集中于当地的替代矫正细胞。
